selection_method: Discovery-first shortlist evaluated for hook, independent photo potential, curiosity, verified substance, shareability and variety.

candidates.concept: Five surprising places across Japan beyond Tokyo and Kyoto
candidates.hook: Five precise locations with strong contrast: volcanic gorge, coastal dunes, snowy village, wild macaques, turquoise pond.
candidates.photo_potential: Six individually identified free Unsplash photographs, different subjects and seasons; crop quality still pending rendered visual review.
candidates.curiosity: Five different physical and cultural phenomena; factual origins add more than a photo list.
candidates.shareability: A concrete wishlist to send someone planning Japan, with caveat that places are far apart.
candidates.portfolio: First East Asia carousel; breaks the Porto/Riviera Europe city/coast streak.
candidates.effort: Moderate; options range from simple buses to forest walking.

candidates.reason: Species/sighting reliability and individually verified destination-specific photo provenance not yet strong enough; would risk implying guaranteed encounters.
Strong potential but requires credible specific access/route distinctions and a distinctive selection of actual licensed location photographs before commissioning.
candidates.portfolio: North African culture/landscapes; could be a later road-trip discovery.

reference_scope.scope: Previous documented full eight-slide and caption inspection in EDITORIAL_BENCHMARKS.md; not freshly reopened in this run.
reference_scope.lesson: One clear regional promise and visual contrast; own selection and captions are original.

reference_scope.scope: Previous benchmark documentation only, not freshly browsed.
reference_scope.lesson: Distinguish practical itinerary details from pure inspiration; this post is not an itinerary.

research_scope: This run read indexed full-text original Unsplash photograph pages, official JNTO, Miyazaki, Hida and Biei tourism information returned by web search. Did not access full Instagram carousels, TikTok, books or paywalled visual references; no performance claims. Original public Wikimedia Commons API imageinfo and rendered preview images were additionally inspected; Unsplash HTML access from Actions was denied with 403 and not bypassed.

claims: Takachiho gorge is in Miyazaki; Manai Falls and walking/boat viewpoints exist
claim_ledger.limitations: Boat rentals can be interrupted and require current checks; no fixed price/hours.

claims: Tottori is coastal sand dunes formed and reshaped by wind; buses from Tottori Station
claim_ledger.limitations: Dunes are not a desert; avoid implying Sahara conditions.

claims: Shirakawa-go is UNESCO recognised; steep thatched roofs relate to deep snowfall; bus access from Takayama
claim_ledger.limitations: Winter photo is seasonal; do not promise snowfall on visit.

claims: Jigokudani has wild macaques bathing in hot springs; Dec–Mar best chance; forest approach 25–40 minutes
claim_ledger.limitations: Wildlife is not guaranteed; park etiquette in caption.

claims: Blue Pond formed as part of volcanic mudflow-control works; blue colour depends on particles and light; bus access from Biei
claim_ledger.limitations: Colour changes and may be dull; do not guarantee vivid blue.

claims: Kamikochi location of scenic closing photograph
claim_ledger.limitations: Closing photograph only; no claimed itinerary stop.

rejected_material: Unverified social media post visuals and inaccessible competitor middle slides are not treated as inspected.
No festival shoehorned into a nonseasonal, geographic wishlist.
No promises of bathing macaques, blue colour, accessible boats, or a single short itinerary.
First rendered Shirakawa-go image was mostly snowless, dark and weak; replaced with a genuine snow-roof Commons photograph.
First rendered Kamikochi CTA was a generic dark hillside; replaced with public-domain Kappa Bridge and alpine scenery.
Commons Tottori winter-dune photos were rejected because snowy conditions made the place look less like the intended coastal-dune discovery; kept the correctly located original photo.
Original Unsplash candidate-page audit returned HTTP 403 from GitHub Actions. No access controls bypassed; Commons public API provided legally reusable alternatives.

Wikimedia original upload host returned HTTP 429 in render; official Commons imageinfo API delivered documented 1920px derivatives via thumb.wikimedia.org with verified licences. Used those public, authorised derivative URLs; no rate-limit circumvention or unapproved mirror.
